data.headline: Find out how ready you are for enterprise management consulting
data.subheadline: METI assesses what you can do today, how you think and work, and what you have actually demonstrated — then shows you the development path that fits.
data.video_body: A short introduction to the future of enterprise consulting, how the assessment works and what you get at the end. Watch it, mark it as watched, then create your account.

sections.title: Work is being redesigned
sections.body: Organisations are rethinking strategy, operating models and roles around data and AI. They need people who can connect the whole enterprise — not just one function.

sections.title: Consulting is a learnable craft
sections.body: Structuring ambiguous problems, researching an industry, designing a target operating model and communicating a recommendation are skills you can measure and build.

sections.title: Evidence over self-description
sections.body: METI weighs what you demonstrate — your case work and written answers — more heavily than what you say about yourself, so your results mean something.

steps.title: Orientation
steps.body: Watch the explainer and create your account.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: Complete your profile, motivation, Talent DNA, values, consulting capability, a written memo and a case study — save and resume any time.

steps.title: Results
steps.body: Get your Summary of Findings, then explore it with the AI Results Explainer — by voice or text.

steps.title: Development
steps.body: Unlock the Detailed Report and a personal development roadmap with weekly milestones.

data.privacy_note: Your data is used only to run your assessments, reports and roadmap. AI helps score written and case answers against published rubrics, and a person can review or override any AI score.
data.closing_body: It takes a minute to create your account. You can pause the assessment and come back to it from any device.
